environment.description: ECS Fargate service consuming from SQS queue. Messages are published to the queue by a Lambda function triggered by an internal REST API (no API Gateway). The Lambda performs basic JSON parsing but does not validate field contents. Any authenticated internal service can publish messages with arbitrary field values to the queue via the internal ALB endpoint.

config.queue: SQS Standard Queue with no content-based deduplication
config.message_source: Internal ALB -> Lambda -> SQS (no input validation on field contents)
config.network: Private VPC, internal ALB accessible to all services in the VPC
config.authentication: IAM-based SQS publish permissions for Lambda execution role
